scenes.setting: The solarium confrontation: Trissy throws everything at him — Demoness, once a man named Tris, his love itself arranged, and the whole romance a cover for a royal deal with the Demoness Sect — and the prince, waking from his scripted infatuation, opens the hidden door and stays behind. 'Let me live in this beautiful story and welcome its final end'
scenes.text_anchor: “Then let me be frank with you. I am a Demoness!”

scenes.setting: Saint Samuel Cathedral: the telegram from Earl Hall's residence sends the archbishop to the Chanis Gate to awaken 0-17 — the only Grade 0 Sealed Artifact kept outside the Holy Cathedral, whose file says it is not an item but a living, mindless angel that has already swallowed seventy researchers. 'She cannot be used!'

Racing the search, Klein reaches an unguarded stone door, strips the armor and slips through the wall with the Master Key — into daylight, thick pillars, and four hooded figures kneeling at an altar. 'Mr. A, are you ready?'
